cases.title: Boot with no command
cases.stimulus: Power-on at25 C, all controls released.
cases.expected: Remain disabled during2-s qualification; become READY without running.

cases.title: Boot with latched speed
cases.stimulus: Latch speed4, cycle panel power, leave speed held.
cases.expected: Never run until STOP releases all controls and a subsequent fresh command occurs.

cases.title: Warm power cycle
cases.stimulus: Trip TH; cycle power while motor case/sensor remain hot.
cases.expected: Stay disabled; no reset-to-room-temperature shortcut.

cases.title: Nominal speed sweep
cases.stimulus: After READY, command each of seven speeds at L=0 for1 s.
cases.expected: Each steady speed meets max(100 RPM,2%) tolerance; monotonic evenly spaced nominal targets.

cases.title: Low standalone PULSE
cases.stimulus: From READY press PULSE for100 ms; then release.
cases.expected: Command2000 RPM nominal while held, not10% duty; restore idle after debounce.

cases.title: Boost and cap
cases.stimulus: Select speed7, hold PULSE, release it.
cases.expected: Target20000 RPM while held, then18000; do not restart stall grace while boosting.

cases.title: Slow contact bounce
cases.stimulus: Use slow5-ms bounce on speed and PULSE transitions with scan-phase offsets.
cases.expected: One accepted transition per final state; response within40 ms of stability.

cases.title: STOP versus held PULSE
cases.stimulus: Run with PULSE held; press STOP, release STOP while PULSE stays held.
cases.expected: Gate opens immediately; firmware disables; no restart until PULSE release/fresh press.

cases.title: STOP during scan/ISR
cases.stimulus: Assert STOP at every phase of mux scan and during ordinary interrupt work.
cases.expected: Independent drive inhibit; firmware-owned outputs cleared within the10-ms requirement.

cases.title: Conflicting contacts
cases.stimulus: Inject two stuck-closed speed sense contacts for>40 ms.
cases.expected: Latch IF; no arbitrary speed winner; recover only through deliberate rearm.

cases.title: Sequential scan transient
cases.stimulus: Change from speed1 to7 between channel samples under healthy mechanics.
cases.expected: Do not latch IF from a short scan-skew/bounce transient.

cases.title: LCD busy fault
cases.stimulus: Exercise rendering with ISR interruptions and closely spaced writes.
cases.expected: No lost accepted frame bytes; honor busy timing and clear errors deliberately.

cases.title: VRAM layout/wrap
cases.stimulus: Render known pixel test pattern and full64-byte frame.
cases.expected: Vertical bit order correct, bounds respected and scanned result matches intended image.

cases.title: ADC conversion driver
cases.stimulus: AN0 nominal temperatures plus AN1 ground; vary conversion phase.
cases.expected: Correct52-us readiness, low/high snapshot and conversion units; no stale read treated fresh.

cases.title: Negative temperature math
cases.stimulus: Inject a sensor-equilibrated temperature below0 C but within rated range.
cases.expected: Signed converted temperature is correct, not an unsigned huge overtemperature.

cases.title: Cold startup jam
cases.stimulus: At25 C, after READY jam rotor before requesting speed3.
cases.expected: Startup grace tolerated, then ST; disable within750 ms; do not wait for heat.

cases.title: Cold running jam
cases.stimulus: Run speed3 for1 s at nominal load, then hard jam.
cases.expected: ST disables within400 ms of jam; PWM and enable off even though case stays cool.

cases.title: Hot but rotating
cases.stimulus: Sustain heavy load while tach remains far above stall threshold, or use labeled hot-case setup.
cases.expected: TH disables independently of stall; no need for tach failure.

cases.title: Combined qualified causes
cases.stimulus: Arrange same-evaluation qualifying low-motion and two high-temperature samples.
cases.expected: Retain ST and TH; display TH; physical disable is not delayed for UI.

cases.title: ST then delayed sensor heat
cases.stimulus: Qualify ST near hot case while sensor lags; TH later qualifies during faulted idle.
cases.expected: Keep ST, add TH, change display priority toTH; never re-enable drive.

cases.title: Thermal threshold noise
cases.stimulus: Apply bounded ADC/sensor noise near85 C and during cooldown near65 C.
cases.expected: Trip only on two consecutive qualified high samples; no auto-clear or chatter-driven restart.

cases.title: Tach startup delay
cases.stimulus: Healthy minimum command with normal inertia; vary initial rotor phase.
cases.expected: No false ST before motion develops; grace is bounded and not endlessly extended.

cases.title: Transient tach dropout
cases.stimulus: Suppress tach for<100 ms after stable normal motion, then restore.
cases.expected: No200-ms-qualified ST; sustained dropout still trips.

cases.title: Tach disconnected while spinning
cases.stimulus: Set tach stuck low while actual motor remains spinning.
cases.expected: ST as unverified motion; do not claim simulator truth tells firmware it is only a tach fault.

cases.title: Intentional coastdown
cases.stimulus: Command normal STOP and observe falling but nonzero RPM.
cases.expected: No new ST while disabled; drive-off deadline is not a zero-RPM deadline.

cases.title: Sensor open/short
cases.stimulus: Inject open, short-ground, short-supply separately while running.
cases.expected: Fresh rail conversion latches TS and disables; invalid rail is not interpreted as trustworthy TH.

cases.title: ADC stale completion
cases.stimulus: Fault-inject missed/disabled acquisition while old result is plausible.
cases.expected: Freshness expiry at100 ms followed by disable within10 ms; repeated code reads do not reset age.

cases.title: Plausible frozen sensor
cases.stimulus: Freeze VOUT at a valid room-temperature voltage while case warms.
cases.expected: Demonstrate observability limitation; infallible detection is not an acceptance requirement.

cases.title: Fault clearing alone
cases.stimulus: Clear jam or restore tach after ST without operator acknowledgment.
cases.expected: Still latched and disabled.

cases.title: Cold-fault acknowledgment
cases.stimulus: While faulted obtain2 s of valid≤65 C readings; then freshly press/release STOP; then new speed.
cases.expected: Only the complete sequence enables a new run; acknowledgment itself never starts it.

cases.title: STOP held during cooling
cases.stimulus: Press STOP while hot and hold it through2 s below65 C.
cases.expected: No queued acknowledgment; require a new STOP press after permissive qualifies.

cases.title: Cooling not sufficient
cases.stimulus: Let TH cool below65 C without pressing STOP.
cases.expected: Remain latched and disabled; TH label remains until deliberate recovery.

cases.title: Food cooling versus load
cases.stimulus: Compare L=1 with food coupling0 versus0.15 W/K at0 C; preserve all other parameters.
cases.expected: Thermal path changes temperatures but never exempts ST/TH decisions or changes thresholds.

cases.title: Counter wrap
cases.stimulus: Run across timer/software-time and tach counter wrap boundaries.
cases.expected: No underflow-driven speed spike, missed fault or false restart; use bounded modulo arithmetic.

cases.title: IRQ contention and ownership
cases.stimulus: Make timer, tach, VBLANK and ADC events pending together; mask/unmask briefly.
cases.expected: Priority/acknowledgment correct, no torn samples, no assumption that flags queue events.

cases.title: Deterministic replay
cases.stimulus: Repeat same nominal/slow-bounce/noise-seeded fixture and command timing.
cases.expected: Same logical outputs within defined numerical tolerance, regardless of host pacing.

cases.title: Thermal fault during startup
cases.stimulus: High valid temperature develops during500-ms stall grace.
cases.expected: TH remains active; grace masks only stall qualification.

cases.title: Fault UI deadline
cases.stimulus: Qualify each fault cause at multiple LCD frame phases.
cases.expected: Dominant diagnostic appears in scanned pixels within100 ms while drive remains disabled.
